name: osdp-embedded
description: SIA OSDP v2.2 protocol library for embedded systems: frame codec, per-message command/reply codecs, PD and ACU state machines, and Secure Channel. Freestanding C11 -- no malloc, no globals, no I/O of its own; the application supplies the transport and (for Secure Channel) the AES + RNG primitives.
keywords: osdp, access-control, rs-485, sia, acu, pd, secure-channel, security
